name: @vectoll/web
description: Vectoll flagship websites — vectoll.org (Open Protocol & WebCrypto Studio) and vectoll.com (Vectoll Cloud & Live Console)

scripts.typecheck: node --check server.mjs && node --check sync-static.mjs && node --check org/app.js && node --check com/app.js
scripts.test: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { for (const p of ['org/index.html','org/styles.css','org/app.js','org/brand/logo-wordmark-dark.svg','org/.well-known/vectoll.json','com/index.html','com/styles.css','com/app.js','com/brand/logo-wordmark-dark.svg','com/.well-known/vectoll.json']) { if (!fs.existsSync(p)) throw new Error('Missing ' + p); } console.log('@vectoll/web standalone static bundles verified'); })"
